text:
Poe Dameron and BB-8's Bestie Moments
Nothing gets between ace pilot Poe Dameron and his trusty droid BB-8, not even the First Order! When Poe battles a Star Destroyer in his X-Wing, BB-8 is right there as his co-pilot, fixing weapons systems and providing moral support. Check out this compilation of some of Poe and BB-8's adorable bestie moments, from surviving explosions to heartfelt reunions.
